info.title: APEX Events API
info.description: A public-facing API for creating and managing events within the APEX platform.

200.description: A response containing the list of age requirements.

post.summary: Creates a new event based on the provided request.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of events based on the provided request.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Gets the number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Gets the page number to retrieve.

parameters.name: IncludeCancelled
parameters.description:
Gets a value indicating whether events that are in a cancelled state
should be included in the result set.

parameters.name: IncludeUnannounced
parameters.description:
Gets a value indicating whether events that have not yet been announced
should be included in the result set.

parameters.name: FromStartDate
parameters.description:
Gets the earliest start date and time for events to be included
in the result set.

schema.description: Date and time in ISO 8601 format, including time zone offset.

parameters.name: ToStartDate
parameters.description:
Gets the latest start date and time for events to be included
in the result set.

schema.description: Date and time in ISO 8601 format, including time zone offset.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Gets a title filter used to match events by name.

parameters.name: SortCriteria
parameters.description: The collection of sort definitions applied to the event query. Example: ?sortCriteria[0].sortBy=StartDate&sortCriteria[0].direction=Desc. Defaults to sorting by StartDate ascending.

401.description: Unauthorized - Access token is missing or invalid.
